note: Judged 2026-09-30. Positive TestRFC3787TLV133IgnoredOnReceipt: an L2 LSP whose first TLV is TLV 133 (auth-type 1 + cleartext password) decodes, keeps TLV 133 as an opaque span, AuthTLVIndex returns -1 and VerifyPDU with no keys accepts it. Negative TestRFC3787TLV133NeverAuthenticates: under a cleartext key equal to TLV 133's password, VerifyPDU returns ErrAuthMissing; a receiver that honored TLV 133 as authentication would authenticate the LSP and go red. Recorded red on packet/tlv_opaque.go::AuthTLVIndex (both).
